card.name: Auxiliary verbs before passive 'be examined/consulted'
card.fires_on: Small helper words (should, be, was, been, the, complete) in label sentences where a passive or reference phrase follows, such as 'should be examined' or 'see full prescribing information for complete'.

modes.label: Should/be before a passive
modes.description: The helper word 'should' or 'be' right before a passive verb about checking, screening or consulting.
modes.example: patients thought to have BPH<< should>> be examined to rule out the presence of

modes.label: Complete in see-full-information
modes.description: The word 'complete' in the highlights pointer to the full prescribing information.
modes.example: See full prescribing information for<< complete>> boxed warning.

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Linking words such as 'was' or 'the' before a described procedure or a reference to other labeling.
modes.example: A detailed physical examination<< was>> conducted.

card.plain: It marks small linking words in label sentences that point the reader to check, screen or consult something.
